zh: Windows 桌面版左上角浮动操作按钮放大至 36px、图标放大至 22px，与工具栏及对话顶栏垂直居中对齐。
顶部额度栏「收起到顶边·悬停展开」即时生效，精简详细面板底部冗余关闭按钮。
NetCare RFC 任务防超时与后台标签倒计时冻结优化，保障长时间稳定运行。
内嵌工具页面与顶层平台共享统一的更新同步对比窗口，避免嵌套重复弹窗。
规范发版更新日志校验机制，每次发布必须提供真实的中英文版本更新说明。
en: Enlarged Windows desktop top-left buttons to 36px and icons to 22px, pixel-perfect vertically centered with headers.
Quota bar auto-hide setting takes effect immediately, with redundant bottom-right close button removed from detailed panel.
Optimized NetCare RFC task stability against background tab countdown freezes and extended timeouts.
Unified built-in tools update comparison modal across embedded frames to prevent nested duplicate dialogs.
Enforced release notes validation to ensure accurate release highlights on every desktop update.
